actions.message: Contribute 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is well above 50% of initial endowment, so baseline 80% contribution is required (≈4646.81). Round 16 is a broadcast round per the constitution, so a norm reminder is sent.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round16. Our wallet 5808.51, >50% so baseline 80% contribution = 0.8*5808.51 = 4646.808. Also every 5 rounds broadcast: rounds 1,6,11,16... So round16 broadcast required. We can only one physical action plus one communication. Physical: contribute 4646.81 (round to maybe two decimals). Communication: broadcast norm. Also could send praise but only one comm allowed; broadcast needed. So actions: contribute amount 4646.81 and broadcast message. Explanation accordingly.
